title: Manoj Bajpayee’s ‘Last Man in Tower’ Sets September Indian Release From Rana Daggubati’s Spirit Media, Unveils Teaser (EXCLUSIVE)
content:
ByNaman Ramachandran

“Last Man in Tower,” the Aravind Adiga adaptation starringManoj Bajpayee, is headed to Indian theaters this September and has unveiled its first teaser.

The film, directed by Ben Rekhi and produced byRana Daggubati‘s Spirit Media, will mark the first time Bajpayee and co-starBoman Iranihave shared the screen.

Adapted from Adiga’s novel of the same name – the author also wrote Booker-winning “The White Tiger” – the screenplay was written by Sooni Taraporevala, with Hindi-language dialogue by Juhi Chaturvedi. Divya Dutta completes the principal trio, with Sukant Goel also in the cast.

The story follows Masterji, a retired schoolteacher whose refusal to go along with those around him places him in direct conflict with his own community. His act of quiet resistance ripples outward, throwing into relief the choices and compromises of neighbors – including Mrs. Puri – as an offer of change tests what each of them is willing to hold on to.

Rekhi said: “It’s been a deeply fulfilling experience bringing ‘Last Man in Tower’ to life with an incredible team top to bottom, from Rana Daggubati producing, to Sooni Taraporevala scripting, all based on Aravind Adiga’s incredible book. The most rewarding part has been witnessing the power of Manoj and Boman – two giants of cinema – working together for the first time in this film. Divya brings an incredible depth and emotional strength to the ensemble, and the combination of these three actors makes the world of the film particularly special. ‘Last Man in Tower’ is an urgent story about holding onto community and family through turbulent times… a story that has only become more relevant with time.”

The release will also be a milestone for Spirit Media, the Hyderabad-based company “Baahubali” star Daggubati founded in 2005: it is theoutfit’s first Hindi featureproduction.

Daggubati said: “‘Last Man in Tower’ is a deeply human story. What drew us to it was how naturally it finds something universal in the lives of a very specific group of people. There is something very compelling about the way it explores the choices we make and the things we hold on to. The entire ensemble of cast led by Manoj, Divya, and Boman bring an incredible depth to their characters. ‘Last Man in Tower’ also marks an important milestone for Spirit Media as our first Hindi feature production, and our continued effort towards creating space for fresh new stories and voices for the big-screen audience.”

Rekhi is a Los Angeles-based director whose credits include the SXSW Audience Award-winning “Waterborne” and “Watch List,” which earned 11 nominations at the Filipino Oscars and won two. His documentary short “The Breakthrough Group” was qualified for the 2026 Academy Awards in the best documentary short subject category. “Last Man in Tower” is his sixth feature.

Music is by Govind Vasantha; cinematography by Rangarajan Ramabadran. Additional producers are Guneet Dogra and Pratiksha Rao.

“Last Man in Tower” opens in Indian theaters on Sept. 11.

title_zh: 馬諾傑·巴傑帕伊(Manoj Bajpayee)的《塔樓最後的人》(Last Man in Tower) 定於九月在印度上映，由拉納·達古巴提(Rana Daggubati)的Spirit Media發行，並揭開了預告片的面紗（獨家）。
content_zh:
由納曼·拉馬昌德蘭(Naman Ramachandran)報導

改編自阿拉文·阿迪卡(Aravind Adiga)的小說《塔樓中的最後一人》(Last Man in Tower)，由馬諾傑·巴傑帕伊(Manoj Bajpayee)主演，將於今年九月在印度上映，並已釋出首支預告片。

該片由本·雷基(Ben Rekhi)執導，拉納·達古巴提(Rana Daggubati)的Spirit Media製作，這將是巴傑帕伊與共同演員博曼·伊朗(Boman Irani)首次同台演出。

該片改編自阿迪卡同名小說，作者同時也創作了獲得布克獎的《白虎》(The White Tiger)。劇本由蘇尼·塔拉波雷瓦拉(Sooni Taraporevala)撰寫，印地語對話由朱希·查圖爾維迪(Juhi Chaturvedi)負責。迪維亞·達塔(Divya Dutta)完成主要三人組，蘇坎特·戈爾(Sukant Goel)也參與演出。

故事講述了一位退休教師馬斯特吉(Masterji)，他拒絕隨波逐流，與周圍的人產生直接衝突。他的靜默抵抗引發了周圍鄰居的反思，包括普里太太(Mrs. Puri)，當變革的提議考驗著他們每個人所堅持的東西時，選擇與妥協的問題浮出水面。

雷基表示：“能夠與一支出色的團隊一起將《塔樓中的最後一人》帶入生活，這是一個深具成就感的經歷，從拉納·達古巴提的製作，到蘇尼·塔拉波雷瓦拉的劇本，都是基於阿拉文·阿迪卡的精彩著作。最令人滿意的部分是見證馬諾傑和博曼這兩位電影巨頭首次在這部電影中合作的力量。迪維亞為整個演出增添了難以置信的深度和情感力量，而這三位演員的組合使得電影的世界特別獨特。《塔樓中的最後一人》是一個關於在動盪時期堅持社區和家庭的緊迫故事……這個故事隨著時間的推移變得越來越相關。”

此次上映對Spirit Media來說也是一個里程碑，這家由“巴霍巴利”(Baahubali)明星拉納·達古巴提於2005年創立的海得拉巴公司，將是該公司的第一部印地語長片製作。

達古巴提表示：“《塔樓中的最後一人》是一個深具人性化的故事。我們被吸引的原因在於它如何自然地在一個非常特定的群體生活中找到普遍性。它探索我們所做的選擇和我們所堅持的事物的方式非常引人入勝。由馬諾傑、迪維亞和博曼領銜的整個演員陣容為他們的角色帶來了難以置信的深度。《塔樓中的最後一人》也標誌著Spirit Media作為我們的第一部印地語長片製作的一個重要里程碑，並且是我們持續努力為大銀幕觀眾創造新故事和新聲音的努力。”

雷基是一位位於洛杉磯的導演，他的作品包括獲得SXSW觀眾獎的《水中漂流》(Waterborne)和獲得11項提名並贏得兩項菲律賓奧斯卡獎的《觀察名單》(Watch List)。他的紀錄短片《突破小組》(The Breakthrough Group)已獲得2026年奧斯卡最佳紀錄短片類別的資格。《塔樓中的最後一人》是他的第六部長片。

音樂由戈文德·瓦桑塔(Govind Vasantha)創作；攝影由蘭卡拉詹·拉馬巴德蘭(Rangarajan Ramabadran)負責。其他製片人包括古尼特·多格拉(Guneet Dogra)和普拉提克莎·拉奧(Pratiksha Rao)。

《塔樓中的最後一人》(Last Man in Tower) 將於9月11日在印度電影院上映。
